rationale: iter-77: optimizer adamw (wd=1e-4) -> adam (wd=0) on iter-71 substrate. Headroom 0.6052 -> 0.6053 (+0.01pp). Marginal KEEP (essentially tied with iter-71). Cross-port from C iter-36 confirms: Adam (wd=0) is non-worse than AdamW (wd=1e-4) on NAFNet substrate. The original wd=1e-4 was near-neutral; not regularising much.
advice_for_others: Near-flat KEEP: optimizer=adam +0.01pp. Cross-substrate: AdamW wd=1e-4 was near-neutral on NAFNet — switching to Adam (wd=0) doesnt hurt. Open question: does this suggest wd=0 is the true optimum on NAFNet? Worth testing AdamW wd=1e-5 / wd=5e-5 in future.
